title: Vuurkrab’s Tweaks
description: A collection of small client-side tweaks to improve your Minecraft experience, focused on PvP, visuals, sound, and more.
body:
# Vuurkrab's Tweaks

A lightweight, client-side collection of quality-of-life tweaks for Minecraft. Fully configurable in-game, safe on any server, and built to grow over time.

Press **O** (rebindable) or use **ModMenu** to open the hub, where every module can be toggled and configured. Every option has a tooltip that explains what it does.

---

## ✨ Totem Tweaks

Tired of the Totem of Undying pop blocking the center of your screen? This moves it **to your hand** and lets you make it look exactly how you want.

### Features
- **Hand-positioned pop** — the totem animation plays at your mainhand or offhand instead of dead-center.
- **Vanilla or custom animation** — keep Minecraft's real 3D model and spin, or switch to a custom 2D animation.
- **Tweakable animation** — adjust scale, duration, swoosh-in, and bounce.
- **Flexible positioning** — independent mainhand/offhand placement, left-hand mode, and a fullscreen position editor.
- **Spin** — optional rotation with adjustable speed and axis (horizontal, vertical, or flat).
- **Glow & rays** — toggle a glow effect with custom intensity and color, or let it cycle through a **rainbow**.
- **Flash** — optional screen flash with its own color and intensity.
- **Custom sounds** — pick your own sound and fine-tune volume and pitch.
- **Import your own effects** — drop a custom glow effect in and replace the default starburst.
- **Test button** — preview the full pop without having to die for it.

---

## 🎵 Music Tweaks

Take full control of Minecraft's soundtrack — and add your own.

### Features
- **Play anywhere** — any song can play in any situation, no more waiting on biome or menu rules.
- **Disable individual songs** — turn off specific tracks by name (yes, even that one).
- **Import your own music** — drag & drop **.ogg and .mp3** files straight into the GUI.
- **Per-song volume** — set how loud each imported song plays, with a live preview.
- **Skip & Previous keybinds** — change songs from anywhere, even the title screen.
- **Shuffle or in-order** — pick how the playlist advances, with an adjustable gap between songs.
- **Seamless world changes** — the song doesn't change when you join or leave a world, and imported songs resume right where they were.
- **Play from the list** — shift-click any song to play it immediately.

---

## ❤️ Health Tweaks

Cleaner, calmer hearts when you take damage.

### Features
- **Instant hearts** — lost hearts disappear immediately, removing vanilla's ~1 second lingering delay.
- **Hearts Fade** — optionally let lost hearts smoothly fade out instead, with adjustable fade time.
- **Fade in on heal** — regained hearts can fade back in as you heal.
- **Hearts Flash toggle** — disable the heart bar flashing on damage and regeneration.

---

## 📦 Good to know
- **Client-side only** — works on any server, nothing to install server-side.
- Requires **Fabric Loader** and **Fabric API**.
- **ModMenu** supported — settings open right from the mods list.
- More tweaks are planned — suggestions welcome!
